# Intentional removals that the kustomize prune guard may prune.
#
# One resource identity per line: kind|namespace|name
#   - namespace is "-" for cluster-scoped resources.
#   - blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# A matching removal is reported by the guard but does NOT fail it. Add an entry
# in the same PR that removes the resource, so the intent is visible in review.
#
# nfs-subdir-external-provisioner: removed because the containerd 2.x
# hostPath+subPath data-loss bug is mitigated by using distinct volume paths
# instead of subPaths, so NAS-backed dynamic provisioning is no longer needed.
Namespace|-|nfs-provisioner
HelmRepository|flux-system|nfs-subdir-external-provisioner

# navidrome: the public music.otakeessen.com Ingress was replaced by a LAN-only
# music.homelab.local Ingress, so its X-Forwarded-Proto Middleware is no longer
# used.
Middleware|navidrome|navidrome-forwarded-proto
